about: Published opening hours for registry places, researched 2026-10-10 from each operator's own website (no third-party sources). Hours apply only inside the listed periods; dates outside them are treated as unknown. Day values: "HH:MM-HH:MM" (comma-separated for split hours), "HH:MM-late" (closing time not published), "open 24h", "closed", "unknown" (the source does not say). Spot-checked against the source pages on 2026-10-10: Neues Museum, Charlottenburg Palace, Restaurant Tim Raue.

plc_berlin_neues-museum.quote: Mon closed / Tue 10:00 am - 6:00 pm / Wed 10:00 am - 6:00 pm / Thu 10:00 am - 6:00 pm / Fri 10:00 am - 6:00 pm / Sat 10:00 am - 6:00 pm / Sun 10:00 am - 6:00 pm
plc_berlin_neues-museum.notes: No last-entry time published. Holiday rules come from SMB's general holiday page. Closed 15-17 March 2027 for maintenance (outside the researched period).

plc_berlin_ddr-museum.quote: daily 9 am – 9 pm ... open seven days a week and on public holidays. On 24 December and 31 December, the museum is open from 9 am to 4 pm.

plc_berlin_museum-fuer-naturkunde-berlin.quote: The museum is open daily until 6.00 pm. The museum is closed on Mondays. Last admission is 30 minutes before closing time. [Tuesday-Friday] 9.30 – 18.00 [weekend] 10.00 – 18.00

exceptions.note: listed without a year on the special opening hours page

plc_berlin_museum-fuer-naturkunde-berlin.notes: Hours load dynamically on the official page; read from the same-domain hours feed. The English page's 'Thursday to Friday' label is a typo; the German page says Tuesday to Friday.

plc_berlin_berlin-wall-memorial.quote: The outdoor exhibition on the memorial grounds on Bernauer Strasse is accessible Monday to Sunday, 8 a.m. to 10 p.m. ... Visitor Center: Tuesday to Sunday, 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. ... Documentation Center: Tuesday to Sunday, 10 a.m. – 6 p.m.
plc_berlin_berlin-wall-memorial.caveat: Hours shown are for the outdoor memorial grounds. The Visitor Center and Documentation Center are open Tuesday to Sunday 10:00–18:00 (closed Mondays except 9 November 2026).
plc_berlin_berlin-wall-memorial.notes: Indoor centres closed 24, 25 and 31 Dec 2026; Visitor Center 12:00-18:00 on 26 Dec 2026. Free admission.

plc_berlin_zoo-berlin.quote: 21. September - 25. October / 9:00 - 18:00 / Last admission: 17:00 / 26. October - 31. December / 9:00 - 16:30 / Last admission: 15:30 / The Zoo closes at 2 p.m. on 24 December.
plc_berlin_zoo-berlin.caveat: Zoo hours only; the Aquarium has its own hours and admission.
plc_berlin_zoo-berlin.notes: Animal houses and restaurants close 30 minutes before the Zoo.

plc_berlin_charlottenburg-palace-old-pal.quote: April to October: Monday closed, Tuesday – Sunday: 10.00 AM – 05.30 PM. November/December: Monday closed, Tuesday – Sunday: 10.00 AM – 04.30 PM. Last admission 30 minutes before closing.

plc_berlin_east-side-gallery.quote: The East Side Gallery is open around the clock. ... [visitor center] open daily from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. ... From November on, the visitor center will be closed on Fridays.
plc_berlin_east-side-gallery.caveat: The outdoor gallery is open around the clock. Its visitor centre (Muehlenstrasse 73, the tour meeting point) opens 10:00–17:00 and is closed on Fridays from November.

plc_berlin_tempelhofer-feld.quote: Oktober: 7:00 - 19:00 Uhr; November: 7:00 - 18:00 Uhr; Dezember: 7:30 - 17:00 Uhr. Nach Ende der Öffnungszeiten werden die Eingänge geschlossen.
plc_berlin_tempelhofer-feld.caveat: Gates close at the end of opening hours; you can still leave through turnstiles at five entrances.
plc_berlin_tempelhofer-feld.notes: The monthly table has no year; read as the current schedule. Free admission.

plc_berlin_deutsches-technikmuseum.quote: Montag geschlossen. Dienstag bis Freitag: 9–17:30 Uhr. Samstag, Sonntag, Feiertage: 10–18 Uhr. Letzter Einlass: 17 Uhr.
plc_berlin_deutsches-technikmuseum.notes: Special-dates list carries no year but matches 2026.

plc_berlin_zeit-fuer-brot-alte-schoenhau.quote: Alte Schönhauser Straße 4 10119 Berlin / Mitte ... Mon–Fri 7:00am – 8:00pm Sat 8:00am – 8:00pm Sun 8:00am – 6:00pm
plc_berlin_zeit-fuer-brot-alte-schoenhau.notes: The nearby Weinbergsweg 2 branch has different weekend hours; these are for Alte Schoenhauser Strasse 4 only.

plc_berlin_restaurant-tim-raue.quote: Dinner: Dienstag – Donnerstag 18.00 - 24.00 / Freitag & Samstag 17.00 - 24.00 ... geschlossen: 24.12.2026 - 04.01.2027
plc_berlin_restaurant-tim-raue.caveat: Dinner only. Bookings are taken only through the restaurant's online system, up to three months ahead.
plc_berlin_restaurant-tim-raue.notes: Sunday and Monday are not listed as dinner days (the site does not use the word closed for them).

plc_berlin_green-door-bar.quote: Geöffnet täglich ab 19 Uhr. ... Die Green Door hat aktuell täglich jeweils ab 19 Uhr geöffnet.
plc_berlin_green-door-bar.notes: Only an opening time is published ('currently daily from 19:00'); no closing time.

plc_berlin_markthalle-neun.caveat: Hall door times; individual stalls keep their own hours. Street Food Thursday runs 17:00–22:00.
plc_berlin_markthalle-neun.notes: No Sunday door time is published; the only Sunday listing is a children's flea market 12:00-16:00.

plc_berlin_nobelhart-und-schmutzig.quote: Opening hours: Tuesday – Saturday from 6:00 pm. We are open by appointment on Sundays and Mondays. [Footer:] Öffnungszeiten: Mo. – Sa. ab 18:00 Uhr
plc_berlin_nobelhart-und-schmutzig.caveat: Sundays by appointment. The reservation page says it is also open on Mondays from 5 October to 28 December 2026 (except 21 December); confirm when booking, as its pages disagree.
plc_berlin_nobelhart-und-schmutzig.notes: No closing time published. Winter closure 1-11 January 2027 (outside the researched period).
